# aeneid-078 — new house renderings

None. No line of X.510–605 is on the house-renderings table or the set-piece list. The most quotable line,
10.600 *Morere et fratrem ne desere frater*, was drafted from the Latin (l "Die, and your brother do not desert, a
brother.”", i "Die, and do not be a brother who deserts his brother.”") and is not proposed as a house rendering.
